customer_wearers_gender_check.name: customer_wearers_gender_check
customer_wearers_gender_check.value: ("app"."customer_wearers"."gender_kind"='unspecified' AND "app"."customer_wearers"."gender_description" IS NULL) OR ("app"."customer_wearers"."gender_kind"='self-described' AND "app"."customer_wearers"."gender_description" IS NOT NULL AND app.customer_text_valid("app"."customer_wearers"."gender_description",60,false))

customer_wearers_birthday_check.name: customer_wearers_birthday_check
customer_wearers_birthday_check.value: "app"."customer_wearers"."birthday" IS NULL OR ("app"."customer_wearers"."birthday" BETWEEN '0001-01-01'::date AND '9999-12-31'::date AND isfinite("app"."customer_wearers"."birthday"))

customers_phone_check.name: customers_phone_check
customers_phone_check.value: ("app"."customers"."phone_e164" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_display" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_country_code" IS NULL) OR ("app"."customers"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_display" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_country_code" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' AND "app"."customers"."phone_country_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' AND app.customer_text_valid("app"."customers"."phone_display",64,false))

customers_country_check.name: customers_country_check
customers_country_check.value: ("app"."customers"."address_country_code" IS NULL OR "app"."customers"."address_country_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$') AND ("app"."customers"."tax_country_code" IS NULL OR "app"."customers"."tax_country_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')

customers_address_country_check.name: customers_address_country_check
customers_address_country_check.value: "app"."customers"."address_country_code" IS NOT NULL OR ("app"."customers"."address_line1" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."address_line2" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."city" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."region" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."postal_code" IS NULL)

customers_gstin_check.name: customers_gstin_check
customers_gstin_check.value: "app"."customers"."gstin" IS NULL OR ("app"."customers"."tax_country_code" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."customers"."tax_country_code"='IN' AND "app"."customers"."gstin" ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$')

garments_provenance_check.name: garments_provenance_check
garments_provenance_check.value: ("app"."garments"."origin"='custom' AND "app"."garments"."template_key" IS NULL) OR ("app"."garments"."origin"='standard' AND "app"."garments"."template_key" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."garments"."template_key" IN ('shirt','blouse','trouser'))

master_services_provenance_check.name: master_services_provenance_check
master_services_provenance_check.value: ("app"."master_services"."origin"='custom' AND "app"."master_services"."template_key" IS NULL) OR ("app"."master_services"."origin"='standard' AND "app"."master_services"."template_key" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."master_services"."template_key" IN ('new-stitching','alteration'))
